en.sayed-ali-raza: Leave me and seek some one else.
We are facing a matter which has (several) faces and colours, which neither hearts can stand nor intelligence can accept. Clouds are hovering over the sky, and faces are not discernable.
You should know that if I respond to you I would lead you as I know and would not care about whatever one may say or abuse.
If you leave me then I am the same as you are. It is possible I would listen to and obey whomever you make incharge of your affairs. I am better for you as a counsellor than as a chief.
